prompt_text: Who is the best branding agency in St. Louis?
answer_verbatim:
There isn’t a single objectively “best” branding agency in St. Louis — the right one depends on your goals, budget, industry, and the scope of work. To help you quickly find the best match, tell me a few things:

- What kind of project? (full rebrand, naming, visual identity, packaging, website, advertising, ongoing brand management)
- Industry (B2B, consumer, healthcare, nonprofit, retail, tech, etc.)
- Budget range and timeline
- Preferred agency size (boutique studio vs. full-service firm vs. freelance)

While you decide, here are practical criteria to use when comparing agencies:
- Portfolio relevance: quality of past work in your industry or for similar problems
- Strategy-first approach: do they show brand research, positioning, and rationale — not just pretty visuals?
- Case study results: evidence of measurable impact (sales, awareness, engagement)
- Team and process: who will do the work and how will you collaborate?
- Client references and reviews
- Culture fit and communication style
- Pricing transparency and timeline realism

If you want, I can: 
- Suggest a short list of highly regarded St. Louis agencies tailored to your answers,
- Draft an RFP or a shortlist of questions to ask agencies,
- Or summarize the pros/cons of a few specific local agencies if you name them.

Which would you like next?
session_note: run_channel caveat: API results can differ from logged-in consumer apps, no memory, no personalization.
